name: url_scheme
description: Complete secure or unencrypted website URLs by supplying the correct HTTP scheme; matched controls complete the hostname in the same URL format.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(96):
 host=random.choice(['shop','docs','news','mail','help','api'])+'.'+random.choice(['example.com','example.org','example.net','test.org'])
 secure=bool(i%2); scheme='https' if secure else 'http'
 desc='encrypted HTTPS' if secure else 'unencrypted HTTP'
 items.append({'prompt':f'Write the URL scheme for an {desc} connection to {host}. Output only the scheme, without ://.\nScheme:', 'answer':' '+scheme})
 control.append({'prompt':f'Write the hostname for an {desc} connection to {host}. Output only the hostname, without a scheme.\nHostname:', 'answer':' '+host})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
